subject: general
question: Who among the following is known as a vocalist in Carnatic Music?
solution:
The correct option is __**GN Balasubramaniam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gudalur Narayanaswamy Balasubramaniam** (6 January 1910 – 1 May 1965), popularly known as **GNB**, was an Indian Carnatic singer.
 
• He was born in **Gudalur**, a small village near **Mayavaram in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• He had also worked as an actor in the Tamil film industry.
 
• He had worked as the **Deputy Chief Producer of Carnatic Music **and also served as the Principal in Swathi Thirunal College of Music, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
 
• He composed over **250 krithis** (a format of musical composition typical to Carnatic Music), most in Telugu with a few in Sanskrit and Tamil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purandara Dasa** is known as the **‘Father of Carnatic Music'**.
 
• **Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar,** and **Syama** Shastri were the three saint composers of Carnatic Music of the **19th century**.
 
• **Sarangadeva,** **TM Krishna** and **O.S. Arun **are some of the famous composers of** Carnatic Music**.
